info.title: Juspay HDFC SmartGateway API
info.description:
Complete API documentation for the Juspay HDFC SmartGateway integration covering all 8 features.

## Features Covered
| # | Feature | Key APIs |
|---|---------|----------|
| 1 | **SmartGateway TranPortal** | Create Order, Initiate Payment, Order Status, Refund |
| 2 | **Payment Links** | Create Order with `expiryInMins` |
| 3 | **UPI Autopay** | Create Mandate, Execute, Revoke, Status, Pre-Debit Notify |
| 4 | **Payment Locking** | Create Order with `payment_filter` |
| 5 | **OTM (One-Time Mandate)** | Create Order with `otm`, Mandate Execute |
| 6 | **Surcharge** | Create Order with `surcharge_amount` + `tax_amount` |
| 7 | **Native OTP** | Create Order with `native_otp`, Initiate Payment |
| 8 | **CVV-less Payments** | Create Order with `save_to_locker`, List Cards, Card BIN, Delete Card |

## Authentication
All API calls use **Basic HTTP Authentication**:
```
Authorization: Basic <Base64(API_KEY:)>
```

## Environments
| Environment | Base URL |
|---|---|
| Sandbox (UAT) | `https://smartgateway.hdfcuat.bank.in` |
| Production | `https://smartgateway.hdfc.bank.in` |

## Content Type
All requests to HDFC SmartGateway are sent as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`. The local proxy server accepts `application/json` and converts internally.

post.description:
Creates a new payment order in the local MongoDB database and on HDFC SmartGateway.

The response includes a `payment_links.web` URL where the customer completes payment.

### Feature Flags
Enable advanced features by adding fields to the request:

| Feature | Field(s) | Prerequisite |
|---------|----------|--------------|
| Payment Link | `expiryInMins` | None |
| Payment Locking | `payment_locks` or `payment_locks_disable` | Dashboard: Hypercheckout onboarding |
| Surcharge | `surcharge.surcharge_amount`, `surcharge.tax_amount` | Dashboard: PG Control Center → Surcharge |
| UPI Autopay | `mandate_auth: true` | PA/PG enablement + Dashboard config |
| OTM | `mandate_auth: true`, `otm: true` | Same as UPI Autopay |
| Native OTP | `native_otp: true` | PA/PG + Dashboard Marketplace |
| CVV-less | `save_to_locker: true` | PA/PG KAM activation |

1_standard.description: Basic order creation. Creates an order and returns a payment page link supporting Cards, UPI, NetBanking, and Wallets.

2_payment_link.description: Creates a shareable payment link that expires in 30 minutes. Send via SMS, email, or WhatsApp. After expiry, the link returns a 'link expired' page.

3_locking_disable_wallet.description:
Hides the Wallet payment method on the payment page. All other methods (Card, UPI, NB) remain visible.

Internal translation: `payment_filter = { allowDefaultOptions: true, options: [{ paymentMethodType: 'WALLET', enable: false }] }`

> ⚠️ Requires Hypercheckout onboarding on merchant account.

4_locking_enable_upi_only.summary: ③ Payment Locking — Show Only UPI
4_locking_enable_upi_only.description:
Shows ONLY UPI on the payment page. Card, NetBanking, and Wallet are all hidden.

Internal translation: `payment_filter = { allowDefaultOptions: false, options: [{ paymentMethodType: 'UPI', enable: true }] }`

Supported values: `CARD`, `UPI`, `NB`, `WALLET`, `EMI`

5_surcharge.description:
Adds a convenience fee on top of the order amount.

Payment page breakdown:
- Order: ₹500.00
- Surcharge: ₹10.00
- Tax (GST): ₹1.80
- **Total: ₹511.80**

> ⚠️ Requires surcharge rules in Dashboard → PG Control Center → Surcharge tab. Without rules, these fields are silently ignored.

6_upi_autopay.description:
Creates a UPI recurring mandate. Customer authorizes via UPI app (Google Pay, PhonePe, etc.).

After authorization:
1. `MANDATE_CREATED` webhook fires
2. Use **Mandate Execute** API for each recurring debit
3. Send **Pre-Debit Notification** 24h before each debit

> ⚠️ Requires PA/PG partner to enable UPI Autopay + Dashboard PG Control Centre → Enable UPI Collect/Intent under Mandates.

7_otm.description:
Blocks ₹500 in the customer's account upfront. Funds can be executed (debited) only once via the **Mandate Execute** API.

Flow:
1. Customer authorizes via UPI app → funds are blocked
2. Merchant calls Execute API when ready to debit
3. If not executed within validity period, funds auto-release
4. Partial debit is supported

> ⚠️ Same prerequisites as UPI Autopay.

8_native_otp.description:
Eliminates redirect to bank's OTP page during card payments. OTP input is shown directly on the SmartGateway payment page.

Benefits: Faster checkout, fewer drop-offs, no slow bank page.

Availability: Only for supported card BINs (Visa, Mastercard — not all banks).

> ⚠️ Requires PA/PG enablement + Dashboard Marketplace tab → Enable Native OTP.

9_cvvless.description:
Tokenizes the customer's card (saves to Juspay locker). On subsequent payments with the same saved card, the CVV input is automatically removed.

After this transaction:
- Use **List Cards** API to retrieve saved card tokens
- Use **Card BIN** API to check eligibility
- Use **Delete Card** API to remove a saved card

Supported networks: Visa ✅, Mastercard ✅, RuPay (limited), Amex (limited).

> ⚠️ Requires PA/PG Key Account Manager (KAM) to activate CVV-less + gateway support.

400.description: Bad Request — Missing or invalid fields

post.description:
Initiates a payment transaction for an existing order. Used in **TranPortal (seamless) integration** where the merchant collects payment details on their own page.

### Flow
1. Merchant creates order via **Create Order** API
2. Merchant collects card/UPI details on their page
3. Sends details to this endpoint
4. Response may contain a 3DS/OTP redirect URL

> **Note**: For the **hosted payment page** flow, this is NOT needed — customers enter details on the Juspay-hosted page.

> ⚠️ PCI-DSS compliance is required for card payments via TranPortal.

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: The order ID from Create Order API

card_payment.description:
Initiates a card payment using a test Visa card. The response will typically return `PENDING_VBV` status with a 3DS authentication URL.

> ⚠️ Requires PCI-DSS compliance.

upi_collect.description: Sends a UPI collect request to the customer's VPA. The customer receives a notification in their UPI app (Google Pay, PhonePe, etc.) to approve the payment.

native_otp_card.description:
Initiates a card payment where the OTP is handled natively (in-page) instead of redirecting to the bank page. Only works for supported BINs.

> ⚠️ Requires Native OTP to be enabled via PA/PG.

saved_card_cvvless.description:
Initiates a payment using a previously saved (tokenized) card without CVV. Use the card_token from the **List Cards** API.

> ⚠️ Requires CVV-less to be enabled by PA/PG KAM.

get.description:
Retrieves the current status of a payment order from HDFC SmartGateway and updates the local MongoDB record.

Also serves as the **return URL** for Juspay redirects after payment completion.

### Status Values
| Status | Meaning |
|--------|--------- |
| `NEW` | Order created, no payment attempted |
| `PENDING_VBV` | Awaiting 3DS / OTP authentication |
| `CHARGED` | Payment successful |
| `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` | 3DS / OTP failed |
| `AUTHORIZATION_FAILED` | Bank declined the transaction |
| `JUSPAY_DECLINED` | Juspay risk engine declined |
| `VOIDED` | Transaction voided |
| `REFUNDED` | Fully refunded |

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: Order ID to check status for

parameters.name: redirect
parameters.description: Set to `true` to get an HTML status page instead of JSON (for Juspay redirect handling)

post.description:
Initiates a refund for a **CHARGED** order. Supports both full and partial refunds.

The refund amount is credited back to the original payment method.

### Refund Types
| Type | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `STANDARD` | Regular refund (3-7 business days) |
| `INSTANT` | Immediate refund (requires Morpheus gateway in Dashboard) |

### Idempotency
The `unique_request_id` field prevents duplicate refund processing. If the same ID is sent twice, the second request returns the original refund without creating a new one.

### Refund Statuses
| Status | Meaning |
|--------|--------|
| `Pending` | Refund initiated, processing |
| `Success` | Refund completed |
| `Failure` | Refund failed |
| `Manual Review` | Needs manual intervention |

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: The order ID of the charged order to refund

full_refund.description: Refund the entire order amount. The customer receives ₹500 back to their original payment method.

partial_refund.description: Refund only a portion of the order. Useful for partial cancellations or returns. Multiple partial refunds can be issued until the total equals the original amount.

instant_refund.description:
Immediate refund processing. Funds reflect in customer's account within minutes.

> ⚠️ Requires Morpheus gateway to be configured in the Juspay Dashboard.

400.description: Invalid refund request (e.g., order not charged, amount exceeds charged amount)

get.description:
Retrieves all saved (tokenized) cards for a customer from the Juspay card locker.

Each card entry includes:
- `card_token` — unique identifier for the saved card
- `card_number` — masked card number (e.g., `411111XXXXXX1111`)
- `card_brand` — Visa, Mastercard, RuPay, etc.
- `card_type` — CREDIT_CARD or DEBIT_CARD
- `name_on_card` — cardholder name
- `card_exp_month` / `card_exp_year` — expiry

### Relation to CVV-less
Cards saved via `save_to_locker: true` appear in this list. If CVV-less is enabled, these cards show `cvv_required: false` — meaning subsequent payments skip the CVV box.

> 💡 Use `card_token` from this response in the **Initiate Payment** API for saved-card payments.

parameters.name: customer_id
parameters.description: The customer ID whose saved cards to retrieve

get.description:
Returns card information based on the BIN (Bank Identification Number — first 6 to 9 digits of a card number).

### Information Returned
- **Issuer bank** name
- **Card network** (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay, Amex)
- **Card type** (Credit, Debit, Prepaid)
- **Country** of issuance
- **Eligibility flags**: Mandate support, ATM PIN, Direct OTP, Tokenization, CVV-less

### Use Cases
- Check if a card supports tokenization before offering `save_to_locker`
- Check mandate eligibility before offering UPI Autopay
- Determine if Native OTP is available for the card's BIN
- Display card network logo during checkout

parameters.name: bin
parameters.description: First 6-9 digits of the card number

delete.description:
Removes a previously saved (tokenized) card from the Juspay card locker.

After deletion, the `card_token` becomes invalid and can no longer be used for CVV-less payments.

### When to Use
- Customer requests card removal from their account
- Card has expired
- Security concerns (compromised card)

parameters.name: cardToken
parameters.description: The card token from the List Cards API

post.description:
Creates a UPI Autopay or OTM mandate directly via the Mandates API.

This is an alternative to passing `mandate_auth: true` in the **Create Order** API.

### Frequency Options
| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `DAILY` | Once per day |
| `WEEKLY` | Once per week |
| `FORTNIGHTLY` | Every 2 weeks |
| `MONTHLY` | Once per month |
| `BIMONTHLY` | Every 2 months |
| `QUARTERLY` | Every 3 months |
| `HALFYEARLY` | Every 6 months |
| `YEARLY` | Once per year |
| `ONETIME` | One-time fund blocking (OTM) |

### Important Rules
- Auto-debit up to **₹15,000** without additional auth
- Transactions > ₹15,000 require UPI PIN authentication
- Customer can revoke mandate anytime from their UPI app

> ⚠️ Requires PA/PG to enable UPI Autopay + Dashboard configuration.

monthly_sip.description: Creates a monthly recurring mandate for SIP investments. Customer can be debited up to ₹5,000 per month for 12 months.

insurance_premium.description: Quarterly mandate for insurance premium collection.

otm_booking.description: One-time mandate to block ₹2,000 for a hotel booking. Execute when guest checks in; auto-release if not executed within validity.

post.description:
Triggers a debit (auto-debit) against an active mandate.

### For UPI Autopay (Recurring)
Call this at least **25 hours before** the intended debit date. A **Pre-Debit Notification** must be sent before execution (see Notify endpoint).

### For OTM (One-Time Mandate)
Executes the blocked funds. Can only be called **once**. Partial debit is supported (debit less than blocked amount).

### Flow
1. Call **Pre-Debit Notify** (UPI Autopay only) → `notification_id` returned
2. Call **Execute** with `notification_id` → debit initiated
3. Bank sends SMS to customer
4. `ORDER_SUCCEEDED` or `ORDER_FAILED` webhook fires

> ⚠️ This is a server-to-server call. Do not expose to frontend.

parameters.name: mandateId
parameters.description: The mandate ID from Create Mandate response

recurring_debit.description: Execute the monthly SIP debit of ₹5,000 against the mandate. Requires a prior pre-debit notification.

otm_execute.description: Transfer the full blocked amount of ₹2,000. This can only be called once.

otm_partial.description: Debit only ₹1,500 of the ₹2,000 blocked amount. The remaining ₹500 is auto-released.

post.description:
Cancels an active mandate. After revocation, no further debits can be made.

### When to Use
- Customer requests subscription cancellation
- Service/subscription has ended
- Mandate needs to be replaced with a new one (mandate details cannot be modified, only revoked and recreated)

### Notes
- Customer can also revoke from their UPI app (Google Pay → Manage Mandates)
- If customer revokes from UPI app, you'll receive a `MANDATE_REVOKED` webhook
- Revoked mandates cannot be reactivated

get.description:
Checks the current status of a mandate.

### Mandate Statuses
| Status | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| `CREATED` | Mandate created, awaiting customer auth |
| `ACTIVE` | Customer authorized, ready for execution |
| `PAUSED` | Temporarily paused |
| `REVOKED` | Cancelled (by merchant or customer) |
| `EXPIRED` | Past end_date |
| `FAILED` | Registration failed |

parameters.name: mandateId
parameters.description: The mandate ID to check status for

post.description:
Sends a pre-debit notification to the customer before an upcoming auto-debit.

### Mandatory for UPI Autopay
Per NPCI guidelines, a pre-debit notification **must** be sent to the customer at least **24 hours** before the scheduled auto-debit.

### Flow
1. Call this endpoint with the amount and execution date
2. Customer receives SMS/notification about upcoming debit
3. Response includes `notification_id`
4. Use `notification_id` in the **Execute Mandate** API
5. Track notification delivery via `NOTIFICATION_SUCCEEDED` / `NOTIFICATION_FAILED` webhooks

### Not Required For
- OTM (One-Time Mandate) — notification is not needed since customer explicitly authorized during creation

parameters.name: mandateId
parameters.description: The mandate ID for the upcoming debit

monthly_notify.description: Notify customer that ₹5,000 will be debited on March 1, 2026 for their SIP mandate. Must be sent at least 24h before.

insurance_notify.description: Notify customer about quarterly insurance premium debit.

post.description:
Receives and processes webhook notifications from HDFC SmartGateway.

### Verification
1. Juspay sends a POST with JSON body + `x-juspay-signature` header
2. Signature is verified using RSA public key
3. If valid, local order record is updated
4. Returns `200 OK` to acknowledge

### Webhook Events
| Event | When |
|-------|------|
| `ORDER_CREATED` | Order was created |
| `TXN_CREATED` | Transaction initiated |
| `ORDER_SUCCEEDED` | Payment successful (CHARGED) |
| `ORDER_FAILED` | Payment failed |
| `TXN_FAILED` | Transaction failed |
| `MANDATE_CREATED` | UPI Autopay/OTM mandate authorized |
| `MANDATE_REVOKED` | Mandate cancelled |
| `NOTIFICATION_SUCCEEDED` | Pre-debit notification delivered |
| `NOTIFICATION_FAILED` | Pre-debit notification failed |
| `REFUND_INITIATED` | Refund processing started |
| `REFUND_PROCESSED` | Refund completed |

> **Setup**: Dashboard → Payments → Settings → Webhooks → Add Webhook URL + select events

parameters.name: x-juspay-signature
parameters.description: RSA signature of the request body

order_succeeded.description: Fired when a payment is successfully charged.

mandate_created.description: Fired when a customer authorizes a UPI Autopay or OTM mandate via their UPI app.

refund_processed.description: Fired when a refund has been successfully processed and credited to the customer.

notification_succeeded.description: Fired when a pre-debit notification has been successfully delivered to the customer. Safe to proceed with mandate execution.

payment_locks.description: [Payment Locking] Methods to ENABLE (all others hidden)

payment_locks_disable.description: [Payment Locking] Methods to DISABLE (all others visible)

otm.description: [OTM] Enable one-time fund blocking (use with mandate_auth: true)

save_to_locker.description: [CVV-less] Tokenize card for future CVV-less payments

unique_request_id.description: Idempotency key to prevent duplicate refunds

order_id.description: Unique order ID for this execution

notification_id.description: Pre-debit notification ID (required for UPI Autopay, not OTM)
